coverage_explanation: Checks the explicitly required OUTPUT mode and sustained 262 Hz carrier on the wired buzzer pin at multiple times, including late operation. This finite suite detects silence, held-HIGH drive, incorrect pitch, and common premature-stop or intermittent-tone implementations.
assumptions: The supplied circuit is authoritative: the piezo buzzer is connected between digital pin 2 and GND; no bench wiring defaults are needed.
A 300 ms startup settling allowance is used because no exact startup latency is specified.
A 3 Hz frequency tolerance allows ordinary timer quantization around the specified 262 Hz.

checks.requirement_quote: Set the pin mode as OUTPUT
